sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 118203 b"
sources.quote: HD 118203 b, formally named Staburags, is a jovian planet that takes only 6.13 days or 147 hours to orbit the parent star HD 118203 at a distance of 0.07 astronomical units.

introduction.text: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 118203. Its orbit and size follow Zhang et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
